visible.description: When false the component renders nothing: no box and no gap, and its cell is removed from Form and Sidebar layouts. Bind it to show or hide the component at runtime.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

agentDisplayName.description: Text to be displayed next to the surface to identify the agent or tool that created it.

iconUrl.description: A URL for an image that identifies the agent or tool associated with the surface.

primaryColor.description: The primary brand color used for highlights (e.g., primary buttons, active borders). Renderers may generate variants of this color for different contexts. Format: Hexadecimal code (e.g., '#00BFFF').

allOf.description: Vertically stacked collapsible sections. Each header toggles its content; Enter and Space toggle, the arrow keys and Home/End move between headers.

items.description: The sections in display order, each with a title and the id of its content child. At least one section.

child.description: The ID of the component shown when the section is open. To show several components, wrap them in a Column.

title.description: Section header text shown on the trigger button. Bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) or use formatString to show data-model values.

multiple.description: When true several sections can be open at once and `value` is an array of indices. Default false: one section at a time, and clicking the open section closes it.

value.description: Two-way: which sections are open, as zero-based indices into `items`. Single mode: a number (null or absent means all closed). Multiple mode: an array of numbers. Bind it to a path to read or set the open sections; a user toggle writes the new value there. Invalid or out-of-range indices are ignored. Default: none open.

Accordion.description: Vertically stacked collapsible sections. Each header toggles its content; Enter and Space toggle, the arrow keys and Home/End move between headers.

allOf.description: An address field for Czech RÚIAN addresses: an ARIA combobox whose suggestions come from the RÚIAN proxy configured on the client. ArrowUp/ArrowDown move through the suggestions, Enter or a click picks one and writes its full Address to the bound path, Escape closes the list and never clears the field. changeAction gets {value} after a selection and after a clear.

autofocus.description: Focuses the control on mount and when its Form tab becomes active.

changeAction.description: Action fired after a committed user change. The context gets the new `value` added.

debounceMs.description: Milliseconds after the last keystroke before the suggestions are fetched. Literal only.

disabled.description: Disables the control. Inherited from an ancestor Form. Bind it to toggle at runtime.

enterAction.description: Action fired on Enter instead of enterBehavior. The context gets the current `value` added.

enterBehavior.description: What Enter does: submit the enclosing Form, move focus to the next field, or nothing. Defaults to submit inside a Form and none outside.

error.description: Server error for this field. Bind it to a path in the errors part of the data model.

escapeAction.description: Action fired on Escape after open popups are closed. The context gets the current `value` added. Escape never clears the field.

excludeFromSubmit.description: When true, the Form leaves this field's path out of its submitted data.

hideLabel.description: Hides the visible label but keeps its slot for row alignment; the label becomes the aria-label.

hint.description: Helper text shown under the control when no error is shown.

label.description: The label shown above the address field; it is also the control's accessible name.

minChars.description: Suggestions are fetched only when the trimmed text has at least this many characters. Literal only.

placeholder.description: Text shown in the empty input. Defaults to the localized 'Start typing an address…'.

readOnly.description: Shows the value without allowing edits, writes or actions; the control stays focusable. Inherited from an ancestor Form.

required.description: Marks the field as required: shows an asterisk, sets aria-required and adds an implicit check that the value is not empty. Literal only.

showDetail.description: Shows the three formatted address lines under the field.

value.description: Data path holding the chosen address: an object {kod, text, line1, line2, line3, ulice?, cisloDomovni?, cisloOrientacni?, cisloOrientacniPismeno?, cisloEvidencni?, castObce?, obec, psc, okres?} or null. Picking a suggestion loads its detail and writes the Address; typing after a selection writes null (an address is only valid when chosen).

AddressAutocomplete.description: An address field for Czech RÚIAN addresses: an ARIA combobox whose suggestions come from the RÚIAN proxy configured on the client. ArrowUp/ArrowDown move through the suggestions, Enter or a click picks one and writes its full Address to the bound path, Escape closes the list and never clears the field. changeAction gets {value} after a selection and after a clear.

allOf.description: A callout box with an icon, optional title, message and rich body, coloured by variant; optionally closable by the user.

child.description: Id of another component rendered as rich body content after `text` (for example a Text with markdown or a Row of Buttons).

closable.description: When true, a close button is shown. Closing hides the alert; if `visible` is bound to a path, false is written there; then `dismissAction` fires. Default false.

dismissAction.description: Action fired after the user closes the alert (requires closable). Adds no extra context keys.

icon.description: Overrides the variant's default icon. Defaults: default, information and destructive use `info`; warning uses `warning`; success uses `checkCircle`.

text.description: Plain-text message shown under the title. Can be bound to a path or use formatString. Default empty.

title.description: Optional bold heading line of the alert. Bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) or use formatString to show data-model values.

variant.description: Meaning and colour (from the theme tokens): default (neutral card), information (informational), success (positive outcome), warning (needs attention), destructive (error or danger; announced assertively with role=alert).

Alert.description: A callout box with an icon, optional title, message and rich body, coloured by variant; optionally closable by the user.

allOf.description: Application shell: an optional sticky top bar, an optional sidebar, the main content area with its left margin following the sidebar width, and a layer for windows. Use it as the root of the shell surface; other surfaces are shown inside its content area.

collapsedWidth.description: CSS length of the collapsed sidebar (icon rail) width. Default 4rem.

content.description: ID of the main area, rendered in the scrollable content region. To show several components, wrap them in a Column. Other surfaces stack below it.

mobileBreakpoint.description: Viewport width in px below which the shell is in mobile mode (sidebar as an overlay, closed by default, never collapsed). Default 768.

sidebar.description: ID of a Sidebar component. It reads and changes the shell's open and collapsed state.

sidebarCollapsed.description: Two-way. Collapses the sidebar to an icon rail; desktop only (the sidebar is always expanded on mobile). A bound value wins over the stored client preference, else the preference applies, else false.

sidebarOpen.description: Two-way. Bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) to read or set whether the sidebar is open; user toggles write it. A bound value wins over the stored client preference. When absent, the stored preference is used, else open on desktop and closed on mobile. Below mobileBreakpoint the sidebar starts closed and closes when the window becomes narrow.

sidebarWidth.description: CSS length of the expanded sidebar width. Default 16rem.

topBar.description: ID of a TopBar component, rendered sticky at the top of the shell.

windows.description: Window components shown in a layer over the content area. A Window portals into this layer wherever it is declared, so this list is a convenient place to declare them.

AppShell.description: Application shell: an optional sticky top bar, an optional sidebar, the main content area with its left margin following the sidebar width, and a layer for windows. Use it as the root of the shell surface; other surfaces are shown inside its content area.

allOf.description: Plays audio from a URL using the native browser player with controls at full width, with an optional caption.

description.description: A description of the audio, such as a title or summary. Shown as a caption above the player and used as its accessible label.

url.description: The URL of the audio to be played. Allowed: http(s), blob: and data:audio/… URLs or a relative path; other schemes are rejected. Changing the URL reloads the player; a missing, rejected or failing URL shows a 'media cannot be played' notice with a link to the URL.

AudioPlayer.description: Plays audio from a URL using the native browser player with controls at full width, with an optional caption.

allOf.description: A round avatar for a person: an image, or initials on a colour derived from the name, or a person icon.

name.description: Person name. Initials (first letters of up to two words, upper-cased) are shown and the name is the accessible label and alt text. Without a name and without an image a person icon is shown.

src.description: Image URL of the person. Allowed: http(s), blob: and data:image/… URLs or a relative path; any other scheme is ignored. If the image fails to load, the initials are shown instead.

Avatar.description: A round avatar for a person: an image, or initials on a colour derived from the name, or a person icon.

allOf.description: A small inline pill-shaped label for statuses, counts and categories, coloured by tone.

dot.description: When true, a small dot in the tone colour is shown before the text (a status indicator). Default false.

icon.description: Optional leading icon from the catalog icon set, shown before the text.

text.description: Short label shown inside the badge (for example a status or a count). Bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) or use formatString to show data-model values.

tone.description: Semantic colour from the theme tokens: neutral (default), info, success, warning, danger.

variant.description: Fill style: solid (filled with the tone colour), soft (light tinted background, default), outline (tone-coloured border and text, no fill).

Badge.description: A small inline pill-shaped label for statuses, counts and categories, coloured by tone.

allOf.description: A clickable button that dispatches an action. Its label is a child component (Text, Icon, or a Row of Icon + Text). Any failing check disables it and shows the first message as its tooltip.

action.description: The action dispatched when the button is clicked. Its context is resolved at click time. Inside a Form with a dataPath, the submit, cancel and reset roles add the Form data as `data` unless the context already has `data`.

block.description: When true the button takes the full width of its container. Inside a Form grid cell it defaults to true unless size is 'icon'. Default false.

child.description: The ID of the child component. Use a 'Text' component for a labeled button, an 'Icon' for an icon-only button (with size 'icon'), or a Row of Icon + Text.

confirmation.description: Asks for confirmation before the action is dispatched. The action context is captured when the Button is clicked and sent unchanged on confirm. With formRole 'submit' the dialog opens only after the Form validates. Escape closes the dialog without dispatching.

buttons.description: Footer buttons. When missing or empty the dialog shows the default pair on the right: Cancel ('default', only closes) then Confirm ('primary', confirm: true).

items.description: A confirmation dialog button: label, variant, confirm flag, footer position and an optional own action.

action.description: Only for buttons without confirm: dispatched on click with its context resolved at that click, then the dialog closes; the parent action is not dispatched. Without it the button only closes the dialog. Ignored when confirm is true.

confirm.description: When true, clicking closes the dialog and dispatches the parent Button action with the context captured when the Button was clicked. Several confirm buttons all run the parent action. Default false.

label.description: Button text.

position.description: Footer group of the button: 'left', 'center' or 'right'. Buttons in a group keep the array order. Default 'right'.

variant.description: Visual style, the same values and look as the Button 'variant'. Default 'default'.

disabled.description: When true the button cannot be clicked. Bind it to a path to enable the button from the data model. Default false.

formRole.description: Meaning of the button inside a Form: 'submit' validates the Form first and dispatches only when it is valid; 'cancel' and 'reset' clear the Form's validation state and dispatch; 'none' is a plain button. Outside a Form it has no effect. Default 'none'.

loading.description: When true the button shows a spinner, is marked busy and cannot be clicked. Bind it to a path to show server-side work. Default false.

size.description: Button size: 'sm', 'md' or 'lg'; 'icon' is a square icon-only button, which then needs a 'tooltip' or 'accessibility.label'. Default 'md'.

tooltip.description: Text shown in a tooltip on hover and focus, also when the button is disabled. Set it for icon-only buttons. A failing check message replaces it.

variant.description: Visual style. 'default' is a neutral bordered button; 'primary' is the main call to action (theme primary colour); 'borderless' has no border or background; 'secondary' is a muted filled button; 'outline' is bordered; 'ghost' shows a background only on hover; 'destructive' is for dangerous actions such as delete; 'success', 'warning' and 'info' use the status colours; 'link' looks like a text link. Default 'default'.

Button.description: A clickable button that dispatches an action. Its label is a child component (Text, Icon, or a Row of Icon + Text). Any failing check disables it and shows the first message as its tooltip.

allOf.description: A single-choice input drawn as a row of buttons, either joined (segmented) or as chevron steps (process). The active button is filled. Clicking an enabled, non-active button writes its typed value to the bound path and fires changeAction; clicking the active one does nothing. Keyboard: Tab enters on the active button, the arrow keys move and select. enterBehavior has no effect.

autofocus.description: Focuses the control on mount and when its Form tab becomes active.

changeAction.description: Action fired after a committed user change. The context gets the new `value` added.

disabled.description: Disables the control. Inherited from an ancestor Form. Bind it to toggle at runtime.

enterAction.description: Action fired on Enter instead of enterBehavior. The context gets the current `value` added.

enterBehavior.description: What Enter does: submit the enclosing Form, move focus to the next field, or nothing. Defaults to submit inside a Form and none outside.

error.description: Server error for this field. Bind it to a path in the errors part of the data model.

escapeAction.description: Action fired on Escape after open popups are closed. The context gets the current `value` added. Escape never clears the field.

excludeFromSubmit.description: When true, the Form leaves this field's path out of its submitted data.

hideLabel.description: Hides the visible label but keeps its slot for row alignment; the label becomes the aria-label.

hint.description: Helper text shown under the control when no error is shown.

label.description: Group label shown above the buttons; it is also the radiogroup's accessible name.

items.description: One button: label, typed value, optional disabled flag and tone.

disabled.description: When true the button cannot be chosen.

label.description: Text shown on the button.

tone.description: Colour of the button (neutral, info, success, warning, danger). The active button is filled in this tone; an inactive one is a soft tint of it. Without a tone the active button uses the primary colour and inactive ones are outlined (segmented) or muted (process).

value.description: Value written (with its JSON type) when the button is chosen.

options.description: The buttons: an array of {label, value, disabled?, tone?} objects, a string array shorthand (label = value), or a binding to either. value may be a string, number or boolean and is written with its type. A string is always taken literally as both label and value; it is never parsed for flags.

readOnly.description: Shows the value without allowing edits, writes or actions; the control stays focusable. Inherited from an ancestor Form.

required.description: Marks the field as required: shows an asterisk, sets aria-required and adds an implicit check that the value is not empty. Literal only.

value.description: The chosen option value (string, number, boolean or null). Bind it to a data path: clicking a button writes that option's original typed value there. Clicking the already active button does nothing. A value that matches no option activates no button.

variant.description: Look of the group: segmented joins the buttons into one bar; process draws them as overlapping chevron steps (for a workflow status). Literal only.

ButtonGroup.description: A single-choice input drawn as a row of buttons, either joined (segmented) or as chevron steps (process). The active button is filled. Clicking an enabled, non-active button writes its typed value to the bound path and fires changeAction; clicking the active one does nothing. Keyboard: Tab enters on the active button, the arrow keys move and select. enterBehavior has no effect.

allOf.description: Month calendar (Monday first) with events. Month and weekday names follow the client locale. Previous/next fire navigateAction with the target month (and write a bound `month`); a click on an event fires openAction; a click on a day fires createAction.

createAction.description: Fired on a click on a day's empty area or its day number; the context gets `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) added.

items.description: An event on one day. Any further keys are kept.

date.description: Day of the event, YYYY-MM-DD. Entries with an impossible date are not shown.

id.description: Unique event id; openAction receives it as `event`.

title.description: Title shown on the event chip. Default: the id.

events.description: Events of the calendar, in array order within each day. A list or a binding to a data path. Invalid entries and duplicate ids (after the first) are not shown. Default [].

maxVisible.description: Events shown per day before a "+N" button opens the full list of that day. Default 3.

month.description: Shown month, YYYY-MM. Default: the current month; an invalid value also shows the current month. When bound to a path, the previous/next buttons write the new month there (two-way).

navigateAction.description: Fired by the previous/next buttons; the context gets `month` (the target YYYY-MM) added. When `month` is bound it is written first. Without it and with a literal `month` the buttons are disabled.

openAction.description: Fired on an event click; the context gets `event` (the event id) added. Without it the event chips are disabled.

Calendar.description: Month calendar (Monday first) with events. Month and weekday names follow the client locale. Previous/next fire navigateAction with the target month (and write a bound `month`); a click on an event fires openAction; a click on a day fires createAction.

allOf.description: A bordered container (card surface) around a single child, with an optional header (title, description) and an optional footer. Nested cards stay distinct through the border.

child.description: Id of the single component shown in the card body. To show several components, wrap them in a Column.

description.description: Optional muted line under the title. The header is shown only when title or description is non-empty.

footer.description: Id of a component shown in the card footer below the body, for example a Row of Buttons.

padding.description: Body padding: 'default' adds inner padding; 'none' makes the body flush with the card border (use it for a Table or an Image). Default 'default'.

title.description: Optional card heading. Bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) or use formatString to show data-model values.

Card.description: A bordered container (card surface) around a single child, with an optional header (title, description) and an optional footer. Nested cards stay distinct through the border.

allOf.description: Chart of category data in pure SVG: line, area or bar (grouped or stacked) with a y axis, grid and x labels, or a donut with the total in the centre. Optional legend; a tooltip opens on mouse hover and on keyboard focus (arrow keys browse the values); screen readers get a summary and a data table. The width follows the container.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used when yFormat is `currency`; shown as the code, never a symbol. Default: CZK.

donutLabel.description: Donut kind only: caption shown in the centre above the total.

height.description: Height of the chart in px. Values below 100 fall back to 220. Default: 220.

kind.description: Chart kind: `line` (smooth lines), `area` (lines with a light fill), `bar` (grouped or stacked bars) or `donut` (ring of slices from `series[0]`, total in the centre). Default: line.

labels.description: Labels of the x positions (or the slice labels for donut), in order. Labels are thinned to about one per 64 px; the first and last are always shown. Default: none.

items.description: A data series.

color.description: Colour of the series: a theme token `chart-1` … `chart-6` or a CSS colour (`#…`, `oklch(…)`). Default: the tokens chart-1 … chart-6 in turn by series index.

data.description: Values of the series, one per x position (per label). Non-finite values count as 0.

name.description: Name of the series. Default: the library text "Series n" (n from 1).

series.description: Data series, drawn in order. A list or a binding to a data path holding such a list. Donut uses only the first series; negative values count as 0. Without any value the chart shows the library text "No data".

showGrid.description: Show horizontal grid lines at the y ticks. Default: true.

showLegend.description: Show the legend below the chart. Default: true when there is more than one series or the kind is donut, else false.

stacked.description: Bar kind only: stack the series in one bar per x position instead of grouping them side by side. Negative values count as 0 when stacked. Default: false.

yFormat.description: Format of the values: `number`, `currency` (with `currency`) or `percent` (values are fractions, 0.25 = 25 %). The axis uses a compact form in the app locale. Default: number.

Chart.description: Chart of category data in pure SVG: line, area or bar (grouped or stacked) with a y axis, grid and x labels, or a donut with the total in the centre. Optional legend; a tooltip opens on mouse hover and on keyboard focus (arrow keys browse the values); screen readers get a summary and a data table. The width follows the container.

allOf.description: A checkbox with a clickable label on its right. Every toggle writes the bound boolean and fires changeAction. Space toggles it.

autofocus.description: Focuses the control on mount and when its Form tab becomes active.

changeAction.description: Action fired after a committed user change. The context gets the new `value` added.

disabled.description: Disables the control. Inherited from an ancestor Form. Bind it to toggle at runtime.

enterAction.description: Action fired on Enter instead of enterBehavior. The context gets the current `value` added.

error.description: Server error for this field. Bind it to a path in the errors part of the data model.

escapeAction.description: Action fired on Escape after open popups are closed. The context gets the current `value` added. Escape never clears the field.

excludeFromSubmit.description: When true, the Form leaves this field's path out of its submitted data.

hideLabel.description: Hides the visible label but keeps its slot for row alignment; the label becomes the aria-label.

hint.description: Helper text shown under the control when no error is shown.

label.description: The text to display next to the checkbox. Clicking it toggles the checkbox.

readOnly.description: Shows the value without allowing edits, writes or actions; the control stays focusable. Inherited from an ancestor Form.

required.description: The checkbox must be checked: shows an asterisk, sets aria-required and adds an implicit check that the value is true. Literal only.

value.description: The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked). Bind it to a data path: every toggle writes the new boolean there.

CheckBox.description: A checkbox with a clickable label on its right. Every toggle writes the bound boolean and fires changeAction. Space toggles it.

allOf.description: Pick one or more options from a list, as a dropdown (displayStyle checkbox) or as a row of toggle chips (displayStyle chips). The value is always a string array, also for mutuallyExclusive. Each change writes the whole array to the bound path and fires changeAction. filterable adds a search box. enterBehavior has no effect.

autofocus.description: Focuses the control on mount and when its Form tab becomes active.

changeAction.description: Action fired after a committed user change. The context gets the new `value` added.

disabled.description: Disables the control. Inherited from an ancestor Form. Bind it to toggle at runtime.

displayStyle.description: checkbox renders a dropdown (single: a list that closes on pick; multiple: a chips trigger with a checkmarked list that stays open). chips renders a wrapping row of toggle chips.

enterAction.description: Action fired on Enter on the closed dropdown trigger or on a chip, instead of opening the list. The context gets the current `value` array added.

enterBehavior.description: What Enter does: submit the enclosing Form, move focus to the next field, or nothing. Defaults to submit inside a Form and none outside.

error.description: Server error for this field. Bind it to a path in the errors part of the data model.

escapeAction.description: Action fired on Escape after open popups are closed. The context gets the current `value` added. Escape never clears the field.

excludeFromSubmit.description: When true, the Form leaves this field's path out of its submitted data.

filterable.description: Shows a search input (in the dropdown, or above the chips) that filters options by a case-insensitive substring of their label.

hideLabel.description: Hides the visible label but keeps its slot for row alignment; the label becomes the aria-label.

hint.description: Helper text shown under the control when no error is shown.

label.description: The label for the group of options; it is also the control's accessible name.

options.description: The list of available options to choose from. Values are strings.

items.description: A selectable option: a label and a string value.

label.description: The text to display for this option.

value.description: The stable value associated with this option; it is written into the value array when the option is selected.

placeholder.description: Text shown in the dropdown trigger while nothing is selected. Defaults to the localized 'Select...'. No effect with displayStyle chips.

readOnly.description: Shows the value without allowing edits, writes or actions; the control stays focusable. Inherited from an ancestor Form.

required.description: Marks the field as required: shows an asterisk, sets aria-required and adds an implicit check that the value is not empty. Literal only.

value.description: The list of currently selected values. Bind it to a string array in the data model: every change writes the whole array, mutuallyExclusive writes [value].

variant.description: mutuallyExclusive picks one option (written as a one-item array), multipleSelection picks any number.

ChoicePicker.description: Pick one or more options from a list, as a dropdown (displayStyle checkbox) or as a row of toggle chips (displayStyle chips). The value is always a string array, also for mutuallyExclusive. Each change writes the whole array to the bound path and fires changeAction. filterable adds a search box. enterBehavior has no effect.

allOf.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column. Give a child `weight` to make it grow proportionally to the other weighted children.

align.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property.

children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID. A template renders its component once per array item; relative paths inside it resolve against that item.

gap.description: Spacing between children: none 0, xs 4px, sm 8px, md 16px (default), lg 24px.

justify.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges (e.g. header at top, footer at bottom), or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together. 'stretch' gives every child an equal share of the height (flex: 1 1 0).

wrap.description: When true, children that do not fit wrap into the next column (needs a bounded height). Default false.

Column.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column. Give a child `weight` to make it grow proportionally to the other weighted children.

allOf.description: A searchable dropdown that picks one option. A selection writes the typed value to the bound path and fires changeAction. Enter or Space opens the list, typing filters it (or asks the server through searchAction), the first Escape clears the search and the second closes it, and the optional clear button writes null. enterBehavior has no effect.

allowCustom.description: When no option label equals the search text (case-insensitive), the list offers a 'Use: "text"' item that writes the trimmed text as a string value. Literal only.

autofocus.description: Focuses the control on mount and when its Form tab becomes active.

changeAction.description: Action fired after a committed user change. The context gets the new `value` added.

clearable.description: Shows a clear button in the trigger while a value is selected; it writes null and fires changeAction. Literal only.

disabled.description: Disables the control. Inherited from an ancestor Form. Bind it to toggle at runtime.

enterAction.description: Action fired on Enter on the closed trigger instead of opening the list. The context gets the current `value` added.

enterBehavior.description: What Enter does: submit the enclosing Form, move focus to the next field, or nothing. Defaults to submit inside a Form and none outside.

error.description: Server error for this field. Bind it to a path in the errors part of the data model.

escapeAction.description: Action fired on Escape after open popups are closed. The context gets the current `value` added. Escape never clears the field.

excludeFromSubmit.description: When true, the Form leaves this field's path out of its submitted data.

hideLabel.description: Hides the visible label but keeps its slot for row alignment; the label becomes the aria-label.

hint.description: Helper text shown under the control when no error is shown.

label.description: The label shown above the combobox; it is also the control's accessible name.

loading.description: Shows a loading indicator in the list while the server searches. Bind it to a data path the server toggles around a searchAction.

minQueryLength.description: searchAction fires only when the search text has at least this many characters. Literal only.

notFoundMessage.description: Text shown in the list when no option is shown. Defaults to the localized 'Not found.'.

items.description: A selectable option: label, value and optional disabled flag and description.

description.description: Secondary text shown under the option label.

disabled.description: When true the option cannot be selected.

label.description: Text shown for the option.

value.description: Value written to the bound path when the option is selected.

options.description: The choices: an array of {label, value, disabled?, description?} objects, a string array shorthand (label = value), or a binding to either. value may be a string, number or boolean and is written with its type. Bind it to a data path when searchAction is used, so the server can replace the choices.

placeholder.description: Text shown in the trigger while nothing is selected. Defaults to the localized 'Select...'. The search box always shows the localized 'Search...'.

readOnly.description: Shows the value without allowing edits, writes or actions; the control stays focusable. Inherited from an ancestor Form.

required.description: Marks the field as required: shows an asterisk, sets aria-required and adds an implicit check that the value is not empty. Literal only.

searchAction.description: Server search: fired 300 ms after the user stops typing in the search box, with `query` (the search text) added to the context. items.description: A card. Any further keys are kept and reachable through relative paths in the actions when `cards` is bound.

column.description: Id of the column the card is in.

tone.description: Colour of the dot before the heading.

columns.description: Columns of the board, rendered in order. A list or a binding to a data path.

emptyText.description: Text shown in a column without cards. Default: the library text "No cards".

gap.description: Spacing between items: none 0, xs 4px, sm 8px (default), md 16px, lg 24px. Ignored when divided is true.

tone.description: Colour tone of the item (danger for destructive).

rowMenuAction.description: Action fired when a rowMenu item is chosen. The context gets `actionId`, `rowKey` and `row` added.

rows.description: Binding to an array of row objects. Client mode: the full data set (sorted, filtered and paged locally). Server mode: the current page only.

selectable.description: Shows a checkbox column for row selection.

selection.description: Two-way binding to the array of selected row keys (rowKey values, or the row index for rows without a usable key). Keys of rows not in rows are kept.

showColumnSelector.description: Shows the column visibility selector in the toolbar.

showSearch.description: Shows the global search input in the toolbar.

sortable.description: Enables sorting by clicking column headers.

stickyHeader.description: Keeps the header visible while scrolling; needs maxHeight.

unhideableColumns.description: Column keys the user cannot hide in the column selector.

Table.description: A data table with typed, locale-formatted columns. Client mode sorts, filters, searches and pages the bound rows locally; server mode sends query changes as actions.

allOf.description: A tab bar that shows one child pane at a time. The user switches panes by clicking a tab or with the arrow, Home and End keys; many tabs scroll horizontally.

changeAction.description: Ext. Action fired after the user selects another tab. The action context gets `value` (the new index) added.

keepMounted.description: Ext. When true all visible tab panes stay mounted and inactive ones are hidden with CSS (keeps their local state). Default false: only the active pane is rendered.

tabs.description: The tabs in display order, each with a title and the id of its child pane. At least one tab.

badge.description: Ext. Optional short text (for example a count) shown in a pill after the title; an empty string hides the pill.

child.description: The ID of the child component shown when this tab is active. To show several components, wrap them in a Column.

icon.description: Ext. Optional icon shown before the title.

title.description: The tab title shown in the tab bar. Bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) or use formatString to show data-model values.

visible.description: Ext. When false the tab is not rendered. Indexes (`value`) still count hidden tabs. Default true.

value.description: Ext. Two-way: zero-based index of the active tab in the full tabs array (hidden tabs included). Bind it to a path to read or set the active tab; a user selection writes the new index there. Out-of-range values show the first tab; a hidden active tab shows the first visible tab. Default 0.

Tabs.description: A tab bar that shows one child pane at a time. The user switches panes by clicking a tab or with the arrow, Home and End keys; many tabs scroll horizontally.

allOf.description: Displays a short piece of text: a heading, a body paragraph or a caption, with a small inline Markdown subset. Use Markdown for long formatted documents.

align.description: Horizontal text alignment (start, center, end); follows the writing direction. Default start.

text.description: The text content to display. While simple Markdown formatting is supported (i.e. without HTML, images, or links), utilizing dedicated UI components is generally preferred for a richer and more structured presentation. Supported: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, hard line breaks and bullet/numbered lists; links render as plain text, images and raw HTML are dropped. Bind to a path ({"path": "/x"}) or use formatString to show data-model values.

tone.description: Semantic colour from theme tokens. default inherits the surrounding colour (e.g. inside a primary Button); muted is secondary text; info/success/warning/danger signal status.

truncate.description: When true the text stays on one line, overflow ends with an ellipsis and the full text is shown as a tooltip. Default false.

variant.description: A hint for the base text style. h1–h5 render headings (largest to smallest), caption renders small muted text, body (default) renders a paragraph.

Text.description: Displays a short piece of text: a heading, a body paragraph or a caption, with a small inline Markdown subset. Use Markdown for long formatted documents.

allOf.description: A labelled text input: single line, multi-line, number as text, or password. Writes the bound value on every keystroke and fires changeAction when the user commits a change (blur or Enter).

autofocus.description: Focuses the control on mount and when its Form tab becomes active.

changeAction.description: Action fired after a committed user change. The context gets the new `value` added.

disabled.description: Disables the control. Inherited from an ancestor Form. Bind it to toggle at runtime.

enterAction.description: Action fired on Enter instead of enterBehavior. The context gets the current `value` added.

enterBehavior.description: What Enter does: submit the enclosing Form, move focus to the next field, or nothing. Defaults to submit inside a Form and none outside.

error.description: Server error for this field. Bind it to a path in the errors part of the data model.

escapeAction.description: Action fired on Escape after open popups are closed. The context gets the current `value` added. Escape never clears the field.

excludeFromSubmit.description: When true, the Form leaves this field's path out of its submitted data.

hideLabel.description: Hides the visible label but keeps its slot for row alignment; the label becomes the aria-label.

hint.description: Helper text shown under the control when no error is shown.

inputType.description: HTML input type for variant shortText; selects the matching keyboard on mobile devices.

label.description: The text label for the input field.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters the user can type.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown while the control is empty.

readOnly.description: Shows the value without allowing edits, writes or actions; the control stays focusable. Inherited from an ancestor Form.

required.description: Marks the field as required: shows an asterisk, sets aria-required and adds an implicit check that the value is not empty. Literal only.

rows.description: Number of visible text rows for variant longText.

selectAllOnFocus.description: Selects the whole text when the field gains focus. Defaults to true, and to false for variant longText.

validationRegexp.description: A regular expression used for client-side validation of the input. A non-empty value that does not match shows an 'Invalid format' error after blur.

value.description: The value of the text field. Bind it to a data path: every keystroke is written there.

variant.description: The type of input field to display: shortText (single line), longText (multi-line; Enter inserts a newline, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter runs the Enter behaviour), number (single line with a numeric keyboard; still writes a string, use NumberField for typed numbers), obscured (password with a show/hide toggle).

TextField.description: A labelled text input: single line, multi-line, number as text, or password. Writes the bound value on every keystroke and fires changeAction when the user commits a change (blur or Enter).

allOf.description: Notification toasts driven by a bound data model array. Use at most one per surface; a second one renders nothing.

duration.description: How long each toast stays, in ms, before it closes itself. Default 4000.

items.description: Required. Binding to an array of toasts [{id: string|number, text: string, title?: string, tone?: 'neutral'|'info'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'}] that the client reads and writes. Push an entry to show a toast. When its timer runs out or the user closes it, the client writes back the array without that id. Entries without a string or number id are ignored. When several entries share an id, only the first one is shown.

position.description: Screen corner or edge where toasts stack. Default bottom-right.

Toaster.description: Notification toasts driven by a bound data model array. Use at most one per surface; a second one renders nothing.

allOf.description: Application top bar, sticky at the top: sidebar trigger, logo and title, start, center and end slots, connection status and optional theme and language toggles. Use it as the topBar of an AppShell.

center.description: Components in the middle, centred in the remaining space (for example a search field).

end.description: Components on the right, before the connection status and the built-in toggles.

height.description: Height of the bar in px. Default 56.

homeAction.description: Makes the logo and title a button that fires this action, for example to navigate home. Set a title so the button has an accessible name.

localeChangeAction.description: Fired after the user changes the language with the built-in toggle, so the agent can resend content in the new language. Typical context: {"locale": {"call": "getLocale", "returnType": "string"}}.

logo.description: Logo graphic shown before the title: an image URL or an icon name.

icon.description: Icon shown as the logo graphic when no imageUrl is set.

imageUrl.description: URL of the logo image (http, https or data:image). Wins over icon.

showConnectionStatus.description: Show the state of the connection to the agent (connecting, online, reconnecting, offline).

showLocaleToggle.description: Show a built-in dropdown with flags to pick the language (Česky or English). The locale stays on the client.

showSidebarTrigger.description: Show a menu button that opens and closes the sidebar. It appears only when the TopBar is the topBar of an AppShell that has a sidebar.

showThemeToggle.description: Show a built-in dropdown to pick the Light, Dark or System theme. The theme stays on the client.

start.description: Components on the left, after the sidebar trigger and the logo.

themeChangeAction.description: Fired after the user changes the theme with the built-in toggle. The context adds nothing; read the theme with {"call": "getTheme", "returnType": "string"}.

title.description: Application name shown next to the logo graphic, truncated when space is short. Also the accessible name of the home button.

TopBar.description: Application top bar, sticky at the top: sidebar trigger, logo and title, start, center and end slots, connection status and optional theme and language toggles. Use it as the topBar of an AppShell.

allOf.description: Plays a video from a URL using the native browser player with controls at full width. Shows a fallback notice with a link when the video cannot be played.

description.description: Extension. Accessible label of the video, also shown in the fallback notice when the video cannot be played.

poster.description: Extension. URL of a poster image shown before playback starts. Same URL rules as url, with data:image/… allowed instead of data:video/….

url.description: The URL of the video to display. Allowed: http(s), blob: and data:video/… URLs or a relative path; other schemes are rejected. Changing the URL reloads the player; a missing, rejected or failing URL shows a 'media cannot be played' notice with a link to the URL.

Video.description: Plays a video from a URL using the native browser player with controls at full width. Shows a fallback notice with a link when the video cannot be played.

allOf.description: A floating window in the window layer with a title bar (minimize, maximize or restore, close), two-way open and state, and modal: true for agent-opened dialogs. Ctrl+F6 moves focus to the next window, Tab stays inside the window. One surface per window is the recommended pattern.

autoFit.description: Fit the window height to its content when it opens. Default true.

child.description: ID of the component shown inside the window. To show several components, wrap them in a Column.

closable.description: Show the close button in the title bar. Default true.

closeAction.description: Action fired when the user closes the window (close button, Escape on a modal window), after open=false is written. Adds nothing to the action context. Not fired when the agent closes it.

modal.description: Dims the window layer behind the window, traps focus inside it and closes it on Escape. Use it for dialogs the agent opens without a trigger. Default false.

open.description: Two-way: bind it to a path ({"path": "/x"}) to show or hide the window by writing true or false; the close button (and Escape for a modal window) writes false, then fires closeAction. Default true.

state.description: Two-way window state: "normal", "minimized" or "maximized". The title buttons and a title double-click write it when bound to a path. Default "normal".

title.description: Text in the title bar. When empty, a visually hidden title (accessibility.label or a localized 'Window') names the window for screen readers. Default empty.

x.description: Initial left edge in pixels. Default 100. When neither x nor y is given, each new window in the layer is offset by 24 px down and right (cascade).

y.description: Initial top edge in pixels. Default 100. When neither x nor y is given, each new window in the layer is offset by 24 px down and right (cascade).

Window.description: A floating window in the window layer with a title bar (minimize, maximize or restore, close), two-way open and state, and modal: true for agent-opened dialogs. Ctrl+F6 moves focus to the next window, Tab stays inside the window. One surface per window is the recommended pattern.

description: TSWebUI component catalog for A2UI v0.9.1: a superset of the basic catalog (forms, tables, app shell, extras).

getLocale.description: Returns the client's current locale as a BCP 47 tag (`cs-CZ` or `en-GB`). Use it in action contexts to learn the locale.

getTheme.description: Returns the effective theme, `light` or `dark`. Use it in action contexts to learn the theme.

setLocale.description: Switches the client's locale (`cs` or `en`). Use it in `action.functionCall`; it returns nothing.

setTheme.description: Sets the client's theme preference. Use it in `action.functionCall`; it returns nothing.

preference.description: The theme preference; `system` follows the operating system.
